conclusions: Retained public-root test correctly proves no-credential discoverability/private framing/no-effects, but is insufficient for new presence-classification branches.

Four old health-readiness root-body expectations are real semantic conflicts; preserve every bearer/island/field-disclosure deny assertion, change only explicitly reviewed root presentation expectations, and remove early-success masking by independently asserting each protected route.

Root projection true/errors delegate existing owner with full original headers/method, preserving configuration/document/Authorization/cookie/session precedence; successful false only selects legacy/public.
Exact staticHEAD200/nativeHEAD405/legacyunchanged behavior is specified; no method-driven credential mutation.
Shared private parser factoring keeps current API parse_cookies Authorization-first rejection and strict limits; no raw parser or identity values enter App.

All four native cookie categories and actual active native session
